error.locked: Passbox is locked. Unlock it in the toolbar.
error.noResponse: Passbox did not respond. Try again.
error.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
error.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Unlock Passbox again.
totp.secondsLeft: {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} left
copy.clears: Passbox clears the clipboard in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and when it locks.
copy.noClear: Clear the clipboard yourself when you are done.
frame.error.invalid: This Passbox window is not valid.
frame.error.expired: This Passbox window has expired. Close it and try again.
frame.openToolbar: Click the Passbox icon in the toolbar.
fill.usernameOnly: This form has no visible password field. Passbox filled in only the username.
fill.noMatch: This login does not belong to this website.
fill.noForm: Passbox could not find the field to fill. Try again.
fill.noMatchPopup: This login does not belong to the current website.
fill.noFormPopup: No login form found on this page.
fill.insecureText: This page uses http://, so anyone on the network could read what you fill.
fill.frameText: The login form is inside a frame that belongs to a different website than the page around it. Only continue if you expected an embedded sign-in here.
menu.unlockHint: Unlock to fill your logins here.
menu.inFrameHint: This login form is embedded by another website.
menu.insecureText: This page uses http://, so what you fill can be read on the network.
menu.savedOnSubmit: Saved when you submit the form.
menu.noLogins: No logins saved for this website.
menu.noCodes: No two-factor codes saved for this website.
menu.downgrade: Saved for https://, this page uses http://
menu.confirmFrame: The form belongs to another website than the page around it ({host}). Click again to fill into the frame.
menu.confirmInsecure: This page is not secure (http://). Click again to fill anyway.
menu.confirmDowngrade: This login was saved for https://, but this page uses http://. Don't fill unless you expected that. Click again to fill anyway.
save.title: Save to Passbox?
save.name: Name
save.hint: Passbox fills this login the next time you visit {host}.
save.updateHint: Passbox replaces the saved password. The old one stays under “Previous passwords”.
save.onlyIfSuccessful: Only update if you signed in successfully.
save.duplicate: You already have a login for {host}.
save.duplicateLegend: Save as a new login or update an existing one
save.updatedHint: Not what you wanted? Undo puts the old password back.
save.error.noVault: There is no vault to save to.
save.error.undoExpired: It is too late to undo. The old password is under “Previous passwords” in the item.
passkey.getHeading: Sign in to {host} with a passkey
passkey.locked: Unlock Passbox to use your passkeys.
passkey.exists: You already saved a passkey for this account in Passbox.
passkey.useDevice: Use device or security key instead
passkey.verifyHint: This website asks Passbox to confirm it's you. Enter your master password.
passkey.error.needsPassword: Enter your master password to continue.
item.belongsTo: This login belongs to {item} – you are on {page}.
item.totpInvalid: This two-factor setup key is not valid.
item.error.totp: This item has no valid two-factor setup key.
trash.hint: Items in the trash are deleted for good after {days} days. Passbox never fills them in.
trash.emptyText: Items you move to the trash stay here for 30 days.
trash.deleteText: It will be deleted on all your devices. This cannot be undone.
vault.noSuggestions: No saved logins for this website.
vault.emptyText: Sign in to a website and Passbox offers to save the login. You can also add items in the web vault.
vault.decryptErrors: {count, plural, one {# item could not be decrypted.} other {# items could not be decrypted.}}
vault.decryptErrorsText: They may have been changed on the server or created by a newer Passbox version. Passbox keeps them and does not delete anything.
signIn.title: Sign in to Passbox
signIn.intro: You need your Secret Key once on this device. It is in your Emergency Kit.
signIn.secretKeyHint: Starts with P1-. Upper or lower case and spaces don't matter.
signIn.busy: Deriving your keys on this device…
signIn.noAccount: No account yet? Create one in the web vault
unlock.title: Unlock your vault
forgot.title: Forgot your master password?
forgot.intro: Passbox cannot reset your master password. Nobody else knows it, and that is what protects your data. Here is what you can do:
forgot.otherDevice: Is Passbox still unlocked on another device, for example your phone? Change your master password there.
forgot.organization: Does your account belong to a company or family? Ask your administrator, once account recovery is available.
forgot.newAccount: Otherwise, create a new account. The data in the old account cannot be recovered.
signOut.title: Sign out of this device?
signOut.text: Passbox removes your Secret Key from this device.
signOut.needKit: To sign in again you need your Emergency Kit (Secret Key starting {key}).
kit.title: Emergency Kit
kit.intro: Enter your master password to see your Secret Key.
kit.keepSafe: Write it down or print your Emergency Kit in the web vault, and keep it somewhere safe. Don't send it by email.
server.chooseText: Where is your Passbox? Enter the address you use for the web vault. Your company or family administrator can tell you.
server.examples: For example https://passbox.example.com, or http://localhost:8080 on this computer.
server.insecureText: With http://, anyone on the network can read and change what Passbox sends, including your vault data. Use https:// whenever you can.
server.error.empty: Enter the address of your Passbox server.
server.error.invalid: Enter a full address, for example https://passbox.example.com.
server.error.scheme: The address must start with https:// or http://.
server.error.host: The address needs a host name.
server.error.insecure: Only use http:// for a server on this computer.
server.error.confirmInsecure: Type “{word}” to confirm the unencrypted connection.
server.error.permission: Passbox needs access to {host} to reach your server.
server.check.unreachable: {host} could not be reached. Check the address and your connection.
server.check.notPassbox: {host} does not look like a Passbox server.
server.check.incompatible: This Passbox server needs a newer version of the extension.
settings.keyOnDevice: Secret Key stored on this device
settings.autoLockText: After this long without activity. Passbox also locks when your screen locks and when you close the browser.
settings.clipboardText: Copied passwords are removed from the clipboard, and when Passbox locks.
settings.afterMinutes: After {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
settings.neverText: Passbox never offers to save logins on these websites.
settings.neverEmpty: No websites yet. Choose “Never ask for this website” in a save prompt.
settings.serverText: Where your encrypted vault is stored.
settings.serverManaged: Set by your organization's policy. Contact your administrator to change it.
settings.serverSignOut: Sign out to use a different server.
generator.pinHint: PINs use digits only. Prefer a password wherever a site allows one.
generator.passphraseHint: Random words: easy to type on a phone or TV and to read out, and still hard to guess.
generator.avoidAmbiguousText: Leaves out l, I, 1, O, o and 0.
vault.shared: Shared with your family or team
vault.sharingWarning.title: Sharing needs your attention
vault.sharingWarning.text: Passbox found {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} while checking shared vaults, for example a changed security code. The web app shows what to do.
item.viewOnly: View only: you can copy and fill this entry, but not change it.
item.error.readOnly: You can only view this entry. Whoever manages the shared vault can give you edit rights.
